_comment: Maps raw VES EE Summary reason codes to plain-language strings for the frontend. Keys are normalized (downcased, stripped). Most values are the full literal text from the 'Plain language reasons' (last) column of the VES Reasons reference sheet, including the '[Name]’s not eligible for CHAMPVA benefits because ...' / 'We mailed [Name] a welcome letter ...' templated copy — the FE renders this string as-is (no separate "because" clause is assembled). A reason with an associated link (currently only the two TRICARE ones) is an object of { text, link: { text, url } } instead of a bare string, so the FE renders the link separately rather than parsing it out of the text. 41 rows / 40 unique reason codes — AUTO-CALC OFF appears for both an ELIGIBLE and INELIGIBLE row; the INELIGIBLE row's text is used since that's the row that needs an explanation. The sponsor-only codes (USC 1151, DIED WHILE P&T, NO CURRENT P&T RECORD, DIED ON ACTIVE DUTY, DIED OF SC DISABILITY, DOAD TRAINING, NO RECORD OF P&T VET, P&T) have no plain-language text in the sheet's last column and map to null pending content team sign-off.
